title: Molly and the Tractor in a Snow Coat
synopsis: Molly sees Farmer Ruth give the familiar red tractor a front snow blade and clear the separate farm lane while hens and sheep investigate the changed winter field.
continuity_state: Before: The town road and garage bend have been cleared and checked. Green Gate Farm has winter snow on the long vehicle lane, hay stored in the existing barn, and Farmer Ruth’s red tractor from hay season. After: Farmer Ruth has operated her familiar red tractor with a front-mounted snow blade to clear the farmyard entrance and long farm-lane approach; the blade is a winter attachment, and summer hay tools are stored. Hay remains covered in the barn. Molly meets Rex by the gate; Little Bridge remains pedestrian-only and not used by any tractor.

related_resources.reason: Supports specific physical facts, not the fictional outcome.

rationale_citations.story_anchor: Farmer Ruth had fitted a broad snow blade to the front of her red tractor.
rationale_citations.editorial_rationale: Farm and compact tractors can use front-mounted snow blades as seasonal attachments for snow removal.

rationale_citations.editorial_rationale: A tractor front blade can be angled or driven ahead to push snow aside and make a path.
